verdict.rationale: Formant offers multiple official SDKs (Agent SDK for device telemetry/commands, Cloud/Python SDK for data queries, RealtimeSDK/toolkit for custom applications) documented with concrete usage examples and a public GitHub toolkit repo. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK quality, no public OpenAPI spec (404s on probe), and no broader third-party ecosystem evidence beyond first-party docs.
